last_scene.summary: Arlequino introduced the next number with 'О героях ...... - Антиматерия -' and performed the full user-supplied lyrics. The unfamiliar word 'антиматерия' and concepts like 'сингулярность' confused many listeners, so they did not become instant experts; most followed the emotional/political story instead. Early lines about something created that can no longer be changed and an empire tearing apart quieted part of the crowd. 'Солнцеликий герой – Я!' drew cheers and mocking laughter, then 'Я цепляюсь за власть… «Тиран!»' caused a more cautious murmur because the previous song had also used the word tyrant. The concrete confession 'Я так их сильно любил, / Что разрешал им дышать лишь в мои глядя глаза' produced open disgust and dark laughter; several listeners mocked the speaker's claim of love. 'Они в восторге орали, но тихли их голоса' and the image of people burning out under imposed feeling hit older listeners more grimly. 'Но всё присвоить себе и всех душить невозможно!' got a stronger approving response. The ending 'Миру явится антиматерия / И новый Герой отрубит голову мне!' triggered the loudest reaction: younger fighters cheered the fall of the tyrant-character, while some older/cautious listeners exchanged looks because of the political language but did not equate the song automatically with Carrion. No palace intervention or protagonist-centered consequence occurred. Some people left during the stranger cosmic terminology, others arrived on the noise. Tips 4s88c, expense 0, personal cash rises from 20g61s44c to 20g66s32c. Rena remains at the inn and has not witnessed this outing unless realistically informed.
